text:
eng-sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: prompt-routing error-rate spike detected on experimental route 'prompt-mux-v2' — 95th latency and 5xx rate rising. auto-alert threshold breached.

maya (oncall): seeing it, joining. can someone post quick impact?

aj: 5xxs ~13.9% over last 3m, p95 latency 2.4s -> usually 450ms. Canary traffic is ~8% of prod.

chris: thanks. any deploys / config rollouts to that route in the last 15m?

maya (oncall): deploy-bot shows: rollout 2026-03-15T18:04:12Z -> prompt-mux-v2 canary (tag: canary-2026-03-15.1).

deploy-bot: rollout  canary-2026-03-15.1 started, 20% -> 8% applied to production via split-rule id: sr_9a7f.

elena: user reports from customer-ops: a paid customer reported timeouts during generation. flagging potential P1 if widespread.

aj: recommended immediate mitigation: flip FF to route stable or disable mux. we have FF: feature.prompt_mux_v2_enabled (staged).

maya (oncall): agree. will try kill-switch for canary slice first. prepping command.

maya (oncall): running:```
# toggle feature-flag for account-wide routing
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"flag":"feature.prompt_mux_v2_enabled","value":false,"scope":"canary-sr_9a7f"}'
```

maya (oncall): sent. waiting for propagation (expected ~10s).

deploy-bot: feature flag change accepted, id: ffchg_77b, propagation started.

maya (oncall): metric watch: 30s -> 2.1% 5xx, p95 down to 560ms. good sign.

aj: keep watch. also open runbook incident: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prompt-routing-failures (see remediation steps).

elena: customer-ops: pinged affected customer with initial note: "we observed elevated errors on an experimental routing. we've disabled the experimental route and are monitoring. will follow up with root cause."

chris: need postmortem checklist: cause=bad canary rollout? maybe model variant incompatibility with kernel on that infra. capture logs + kernel traces from GPUs servicing sr_9a7f.

maya (oncall): collecting logs, cc @thomas for infra trace pickup. attaching snippet of error logs: ```
[2026-03-15T18:06:10Z] prompt-mux-v2 | model-runner | ERROR | kv-cache mismatch, invalid token index -> abort stream
[2026-03-15T18:06:11Z] prompt-mux-v2 | gateway | 502 Gateway Error | upstream model instance OOM
```

thomas: I'll grab GPU OOMs and kernel crash logs now. suspect quantization path mismatch on that model.

aj: for now, keep stable route pinned, do not roll forward canary. set alert threshold lower for 1h.

maya (oncall): doing that. setting: alert->sensitivity high for 60m.

customer-ops: customer accepted initial note, asked for ETA and whether any data loss. we responded: no data loss detected, only request failures/timeouts. will provide RCA when available.

chris: handoff: maya -> thomas for deeper infra/trace. thomas you're on-call next 4h?

thomas: yes, taking over. maya please summarize what you did and paste links to logs + FF change id.

maya (oncall): summary: 1) observed elevated 5xx and latency on prompt-mux-v2 canary; 2) verified rollout canary-2026-03-15.1 active for slice sr_9a7f; 3) toggled feature.prompt_mux_v2_enabled=false scoped to canary slice (ffchg_77b) at 2026-03-15T18:06:30Z; 4) errors dropped from ~13.9% -> ~2.0% in 90s; 5) opened PM ticket and linked runbook. logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/streams/ffchg_77b ; traces: https://redwood.internal/traces/trace_9a7f

thomas: got it. I'll continue root cause and coordinate patch (likely model binary recompile / kernel fallback). ping me in #eng-runtime if I need rollout help.

elena: marking incident as mitigated for customer comms; will schedule a follow-up message with ETA for RCA by EOD.

maya (oncall): leaving notes in incident tracker, adding labels: "feature-flag-kill-switch", "canary-failure", "customer-impact". handing to thomas.

eng-sre-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=high -> monitoring. assignee=thomas.

chris: reminder: do not re-enable canary until verified with hotfix and full regression on staging.

thomas: acknowledged. will coordinate validation matrix and propose conservative rollout plan (start 1% -> 5% -> 10% with heavy KV/cache warmup).

customer-ops: we'll keep customer updated. thanks team. :thumbsup:

maya (oncall): thanks all, signing off. :wave:
